svg.title: Design overview
svg.desc: The drawing reads left to right. The outstation and the master sit outside one programmable switch. Inside it, ingress classifies each arrival and arms its release deadlines; the read lane holds the acknowledgment and the response of a READ or SELECT, and the control lane holds an OPERATE. Each held packet waits behind a queue of blocker packets the switch generates, which a strict-priority scheduler drains first, and the blocker loopback returns into those queues without reaching a cable.

g.text: blocker packets recirculate, and reach no cable
